name: solarabase_retrieve
description: Retrieve the most relevant document passages from the Solarabase knowledge base for a query. Returns raw text chunks — each with the source document title, page number, and a relevance score — and does NOT run an LLM over them. This is your primary RAG tool: retrieve first, then read the passages and ground your own answer in them, citing the document and page.

query.description: The search query / question to find relevant passages for (1-32000 characters)

max_pages.description: Maximum number of passages to return (default 10, max 100)
